title: Cyberpunk Arcade Battle
description: A surreal cyberpunk scene shows two large white and grey mechs battling in fighting stances on a cracked road. In the foreground, a hand holds a retro handheld game console displaying 'PAUSED', while an arcade cabinet stands on the right. The dramatic sky features a massive swirling vortex with a central golden eye, purple tentacles dripping blue liquid, and floating papers.
